admission.justification: Active LanguageSet scoping and cache-key isolation, declarative tags.scm extraction with .lean reservation, and declarative tests.scm case-call capture together guarantee consistent language-agnostic anchor resolution across writer, conversion, currentness, recorded reads, and test isolation without per-language AST walkers or cross-set cache leakage.

guarantee: Every tree-sitter citation consumer resolves source bindings and JS/TS test-case call sites declaratively through the active LanguageSet ContextVar and language-agnostic tags.scm/tests.scm engine, derives extractor identity from pinned versions and query digests across all downstream caches, and keeps .lean permanently reserved for the built-in Lean declaration scanner.
title: Declarative LanguageSet and tags.scm citation extraction seam
